unit_rules.name: The Duellist
unit_rules.text:
At the start of the Battle Round, select one of the following:
* If this unit is not within Melee Distance of an enemy, remove it from the Battlefield and place it into Reserves.
* Until the end of the Battle Round: friendly +Shattered Legions+ units within 6" have !Feel No Pain 4+! against mortal damage.
* When your opponent targets their unit within 12" with a Strategem, gain 1 CP and the targeted unit must take a Battle-Shock test before resolving the Strategem. If failed, the unit is Battle-Shocked and the Strategem has no effect.

unit_rules.name: Bodyguards of the Duellist
unit_rules.text: While within 3" of a friendly +Shattered Legions+ +Infantry+ unit, this model has +Lone Operative+.
